mentions.name: Hunt Your Tribe
mentions.description: This is a portfolio-first applicant tracking system (ATS) for hiring that replaces resumes as the primary people-discovery tool. It automatically captures candidate signals in real time from GitHub, blogs, and case study documents, and showcases them comprehensively to employers. It encourages people to keep their portfolio websites up to date through journaling, and takes a balanced SaaS-plus-AI-integration approach rather than an AI-heavy one.
mentions.problem: Resumes have been the primary people-discovery tool for decades, but nobody likes updating boring resume content, and they provide weaker signals than a personal website or portfolio.
mentions.source_excerpt: We are working on https://huntyourtribe.com, portfolio-first ATS for hiring
